Dennis Liddy

Dennis Liddy came over to my house sometime last year to buy a fiddle from me and he played this tune. I since learned the tune from Michael Harty the flute player but this setting may not be Dennis’s as I have not heard his recording of it on Waifs and strays. Must get a copy.
Good Luck
Mikea

Billy Brockers

A year has passed since I heard Dennis play this tune, and as I said this setting comes from Micheal Harty who got it from Paddy O’Brien from Co Tipperary. Tunes change with time Tanya, who knows exactly how this one started out.
Good Luck
Mikea

Billy Brocker’s

Here’s a transcription I did of Edel Fox’s playing on the Clare FM Kitchen Session (Season 1 Show 2) at Patsy O’Grady’s house in Knockadangan, Kilmaley. She played it three times changing a couple of notes here and there each time. There were a few chords, cuts, and other occasional ornaments that I couldn’t catch (but which are very specific to the concertina).
